Proof in the paper: The XRD spectrum of the pure Ni(OH)2 film shows diffraction peaks at the 2θ angles of 19.34, 33.15, 38.67, 52.16, 59.11, 62.80, 72.89, and 82.01°, which are associated with the (001), (100), (101), (102), (110), (111), (103), and (202) reflection planes, respectively, of the layered β-Ni(OH)2 phase (JCPDS 14-0117). (42) A clear feature appears at 34.23° following the incorporation of V into the Ni(OH)2 matrix, which corresponds to the characteristic (009) facet of the NiV LDH (PDF 52-1627), indicating that the deposited films are isomorphous, like layered β-Ni(OH)2.
